description: Standardized Protocol for Dynamic Temporal Windowing, Multi-Modal Event Packaging, and Controlled/Naturalistic Capture.

pre_window_sizing.purpose: Capture baseline unperturbed trajectories, velocities, and initial secondary zone occupancy prior to interaction onset.

intervention_window_sizing.definition: Window spanning first detection of brake actuation or steering deviation until completion of avoidance maneuver or complete vehicle halt.
intervention_window_sizing.telemetry_trigger: Brake switch active OR deceleration > 1.0 m/s2 OR steering angle change rate > 15 deg/s.

post_window_sizing.purpose: Observe whether secondary hazard emerges within the dynamic propagation latency window.

scenario_taxonomies_required_in_dataset.description: Close approach leading to emergency braking to a full stop without lateral swerve; secondary zone unpenetrated and hazard unchanged.
Nominal passing maneuver where both vehicle and pedestrian vacate the corridor with zero secondary hazard.
Vehicle executes lateral evasive swerve into an observable adjacent zone that is physically verified as clear and unoccupied.
Vehicle intervenes in primary corridor; secondary risk increases due to an independent pedestrian group or external forklift entering.
Vehicle intervenes and swerves; the redirected vehicle trajectory directly encroaches upon an occupied, observable secondary zone.
Vehicle executes swerve during which the object detector swaps track IDs or fragments tracks.
Vehicle swerves toward a cross-aisle whose interior depth is occluded by pallets, testing state machine refusal to classify.
Secondary risk increases, but warehouse architectural blind corners prevent confirming whether an independent actor entered.
Video stream drops or clip terminates within 2.0s of intervention, testing temporal completeness gate.

controlled_safety_trials.purpose: Systematically test counterfactual hypotheses (baseline vs. intervention configuration) under rigorous experimental controls.
safety_and_ethics_rules: NO human pedestrian may ever be placed in the physical collision path of a moving vehicle.
Pedestrian obstacles in collision trajectories MUST be certified soft foam dummies or mannequins.
Human test participants MUST remain in certified safety cages or physically partitioned observation zones.
Vehicle MUST be equipped with hardware-enforced remote safety emergency stop (E-Stop) operated by a designated safety observer.
controlled_safety_trials.paired_counterfactual_design: Record Run A (vehicle maintains path past empty junction) vs. Run B (vehicle executes evasive swerve into adjacent instrumented zone) under identical lighting and floor conditions.

naturalistic_operational_capture.purpose: Capture ambient warehouse logistics operations to prevent dataset overfitting to artificial test patterns.
naturalistic_operational_capture.protocol: Continuous multi-camera facility surveillance across operational shifts, triggering candidate extraction upon CAN telemetry deceleration peaks.

required_fields: timestamps (T0_start, T1_interv, T2_interv_end, T3_primary_res, T4_sec_onset, T5_post_end)
evidence_source_tag_taxonomy: DIRECT_PHYSICAL_OBSERVATION (CAN bus, surveyed geometry, calibrated lux)
VIDEO_DERIVED (bounding boxes, optical flow, visual kinematics)
TELEMETRY_DERIVED (integrated vehicle pose, velocity from encoders)
SENSOR_DERIVED (LiDAR point clouds, UWB tag coordinates)
MODEL_DERIVED (Model H risk score, heuristic convergence score)
evidence_object_schema.ground_truth_isolation_rule: MODEL_DERIVED data shall NEVER be tagged as GROUND_TRUTH or used as adjudication labels.
